raw_payload.cinematic_image_prompt: A photorealistic cinematic shot of the observation deck of the deep‑space research station Kepler‑9 at night, captured with a 35mm anamorphic lens, IMAX film texture, 8K resolution. The sleek metallic interior features large panoramic windows revealing a swirling violet nebula of the Cygnus sector. Volumetric lighting from the nebula casts a soft violet glow across the deck, while the station’s own lights flicker in rhythmic amber, creating chiaroscuro contrast. In the foreground Elena Vance reaches to tap a glowing comm‑link on her wrist, the device emitting a faint blue pulse. Crew members stand behind consoles, their silhouettes illuminated by console panels. A subtle atmospheric haze and floating dust motes catch the light, adding depth. The color palette blends deep blues, violets, metallic silvers, and warm amber highlights, conveying a triumphant mood.
raw_payload.cinematic_video_prompt: Cinematic video of the same observation deck, beginning with a slow dolly‑in on Elena Vance as she taps the glowing comm‑link on her wrist, then a low‑angle tilt upward to capture the violet nebula through the windows. A smooth tracking sweep moves across the deck, showing crew members snapping to attention and hurrying to consoles and the launch bay. Deck lights flicker in sync with the signal, creating dynamic lighting changes. Include subtle environmental motion: floating dust particles illuminated by nebula light, a faint vibration of the rising hum expressed as slight camera shake, and a gentle breeze moving a transparent panel. Shot with a 50mm anamorphic feel, IMAX quality, 8K resolution, the motion emphasizes the triumphant crescendo of the scene.
